memberApi._note: Member-app API, discovered 2026-08-27 by extracting the Hermes string table from the installed APK (assets/index.android.bundle) and probing the gateway. The mobile MCP observes no traffic and mitmproxy stays rejected (.claude/steering/mobile-mcp-rule.md) — this is endpoint DISCOVERY for data seeding, not request interception. Never use it to assert what the app sent.
memberApi.host: https://dashboard.aqxotc-sit.s20ip12.com — same gateway as Back Office
memberApi._deviceIdHeader: MUST be spelled `X-Device-Id`. `Device-ID`, `deviceId`, `device-id`, `deviceid` and `Device_Id` are all IGNORED and return AUTH-DEVICE-002. `X-Device-ID` and `x-device-id` reach the OTP branch instead. Only `X-Device-Id` returns a token straight away.
memberApi._deviceId: f6918f295fd7078d — Settings.Secure.android_id of AVD pixel6, already enrolled for mth2608@mailinator.com, so login returns a token with NO email OTP. A different device id triggers enrollment + OTP.
memberApi._rateLimit: Repeated logins hit VERIFY-CODE-006 "Please wait 1 minute(s) to resend verification." Cache the token; do not re-login in a loop.
memberApi._createEndpointsTodo: The bank-account / crypto-address CREATE verbs were NOT in the string table. Resolve them against the live API before seeding.
memberApi._apkExtraction: adb root; adb pull <pm path com.bfgto.sit.app>; unzip; strings -n 4 assets/index.android.bundle. Hermes bytecode v98 — the string table is length-prefixed, so `strings -n 8` misses most of it and paths come out concatenated with neighbours.
memberApi._STATUS: PARTIAL — discovery succeeded, seeding did NOT. Login returns only a pre-2FA token; the second-factor verify endpoint was not found, so no member endpoint can be called yet. Seed data through the app UI until this is resolved.
memberApi._twoFactorBlocker: POST /api/auth/public/app/login returns result.otcTokenType=EMAIL_OTP and a JWT whose claim is type=GOOGLE_AUTHENTICATOR — a pre-2FA token. Every /api/backoffice/app/* call with it returns AUTH-LOGIN-101 'Invalid Token'. The login DOES send a real email OTP (retrievable via scripts/mailinator_otp.py), but the endpoint that exchanges partial-token + OTP for a session token was not located.
memberApi._verifyProbesTried: Bodies {otp} {code} {otpCode} {email,otp} {verificationCode} against: /api/backoffice/app/otp/email/verify, /api/auth/app/verify, /api/auth/app/otp/verify, /api/auth/app/otp/email/verify, /api/auth/public/app/verify, /api/auth/app/login/verify, /api/auth/app/device-enrollment, /api/onboarding/public/app/otp/email/verify, /api/auth/backend/app/verify, /api/auth/app/2fa/verify, /api/auth/public/app/otp/email/verify. All either AUTH-LOGIN-101 or COMMON-003 'Internal error'.
memberApi._statusCodeTell: On this gateway 500 = route exists but the handler threw (bad body); 400 = no such route. /api/auth/public/app/verify and /api/auth/public/app/otp/email/verify both 500, so one of them may be right with a body shape not yet guessed.
memberApi._deadEnds: 1) adb logcat — release build logs no network. 2) OkHttp disk cache at files/okhttp — holds only assets.eascdn.net Expo asset downloads, no API calls. 3) Session token is NOT persisted: AsyncStorage holds only INTERNAL_USER and PASSCODE; SecureStore holds only an AES-encrypted ENROLLED_MEMBER_ID. The live token is memory-only.
memberApi._nextStep: Ask the app/BE team for the login 2FA verify endpoint and its request body. Everything else needed to drive the member API is already recorded here.
